Class Cycle

java.lang.Object
masroofy.model.Cycle
public class Cycle extends Object
Budget cycle metadata persisted in SQLite.

US #1 needs the total allowance plus a start and end date. Dates are stored as ISO strings (yyyy-MM-dd) in the database.

    • isAlert80Shown

      public boolean isAlert80Shown()
      Returns whether the 80% warning was already shown for this cycle (US #6).

      Persisted in SQLite to avoid spamming the user with repeated warnings.

      true if warning already shown
